title: ever PALMER|Sequin Embroidery Mermaid Formal Dress
descriptionHtml:
This enchanting evening dress features elegant floral sequins that catch the light beautifully. The ruffled sleeves add a romantic touch, making it perfect for various occasions, from weddings to cocktail parties. The mermaid silhouette flatters your curves while allowing you to move gracefully. Crafted from high-quality materials, this dress ensures comfort and style for a standout look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Ankle-Length


Sleeve Style: Ruffle Sleeve


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back


Undergarments:Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch
